opinions.text:
Per Curiam:
Appellant Douglas Ready appeals from the entry of a full order of protection against him by the Circuit Court of Callaway County. In his first point on appeal, Ready argues that the trial judge should have sua sponte recused from hearing the matter. In his second point on appeal, Ready argues that the court misapplied the law regarding the award of attorney's fees. We affirm. Rule 84.16(b).
